script_text: Gemini — this week your ruling planet Mercury ignites your 6th House of Work, and the energy hits hard by Tuesday. Sun conjunct Mercury in Virgo sharpens your mind, but Mars square Saturn in your 10th House creates career friction mid-week — hold off on big decisions until Thursday. Venus enters Libra and activates your 7th House of Partnerships Wednesday, pulling love and career into alignment. Your Air element gives you the clarity to navigate relationship tension Friday and Saturday. Monday is your best day — Mercury conjunct Sun in your 6th House fuels productivity. Wednesday is your power day because Venus enters your 7th House, bringing a love opportunity. Avoid Friday when Mercury squares Neptune — confusion clouds judgment. Love prediction: A Wednesday conversation redefines a bond — be vulnerable. Career prediction: 10th House tension resolves Saturday, reopening a closed door. Write down three career goals Monday morning. Follow for daily updates.
